name: feathery
label: Feathery
description: Build powerful forms, workflows, and document automation.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

update_form.label: Update Form
update_form.description: Update a form's properties including status and translations.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the form should be enabled or disabled.

translations.label: Translations
translations.description: Add translations for form text. Note: This will override existing translations.

list_form_submissions.label: List Form Submissions
list_form_submissions.description: List submission data for a particular form.

form_id.label: Form
form_id.description: Select the form to get submissions for.

start_time.label: Start Time
start_time.description: Limit submissions to after this update time.

end_time.label: End Time
end_time.description: Limit submissions to before this update time.

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Limit submissions to after this creation time.

created_before.label: Created Before
created_before.description: Limit submissions to before this creation time.

count.label: Count
count.description: Limit the number of returned submissions.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated list of field IDs to return.

no_field_values.label: Exclude Field Values
no_field_values.description: Don't return field data. More performant for large datasets.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: How to sort the returned field values.

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Number of results per page (default 500, max 1000).

use_cache.label: Use Cache
use_cache.description: Use cached data for faster response (may be a few minutes old).

field_search.label: Field Search
field_search.description: Search for submissions with specific field values.

fuzzy_search_threshold.label: Fuzzy Search Threshold
fuzzy_search_threshold.description: Score threshold between 0 and 1 for fuzzy search.

fuzzy_search_parameters.label: Fuzzy Search Parameters
fuzzy_search_parameters.description: Fields and terms for fuzzy search. Weights must sum to 1.

export_submission_pdf.label: Export Form Submission PDF
export_submission_pdf.description: Create a PDF export for a specific form submission.

form_id.label: Form
form_id.description: Select the form to export submission from.

user_id.label: User
user_id.description: Select the user whose submission to export.
